name: IL-07
label: Safe D

key_factors: Ford's large fundraising edge over Koppie
Open seat after Danny Davis's retirement
model.rationale: This Chicago-area seat is one of the most Democratic in the country at D+34, and prediction markets price a Democratic win near certain. La Shawn Ford has outraised Chad Koppie by more than ten to one, and Koppie's negligible cash on hand signals no serious general-election operation.
model.watch: A surprise scandal or an unusually strong Republican national environment could narrow the margin, though a Republican win remains highly unlikely.
notes: No expert rater lists this race; treated as safe for the party holding the seat.
No usable general-election polls; forecast rests on fundamentals and expert ratings.
Open seat: Danny Davis (D) is not on the ballot.

overview:
Danny Davis's retirement opens a heavily Democratic Chicago seat, but the party's hold is not in serious doubt. The district's D+34 partisan lean means a Republican candidate would need a historic swing to compete. La Shawn Ford, the Democratic nominee, has raised over $700,000 and holds a six-figure war chest, while Republican Chad Koppie has raised about $55,000 with essentially no cash on hand.

Outside spending has flowed heavily against the Republican nominee, and prediction markets price the Democratic side at roughly 97%. With no public polls and no expert ratings, the forecast rests on fundamentals, which point to a comfortable Democratic hold in the mid-twenties to low-thirties margin range.
